_about: Dry-run, PROMPT_isomir_variants_4.0.0.md Part 1, with the rules approved on 2026-11-21. Read-only. Overhang 6 nt unless stated; R2 factor 0.8 is an own threshold of the tool, not calibrated. Shares are pooled over all isomiRdb samples.

reconciliation.old_unclassified_537: 526 prefix mismatches (tail 241 + 5' offset 173 + internal 112) already include 5 mlv3p/mv variants; adding mlv3p 15 + mv 1 counts those 5 twice: 526 + 11 = 537
reconciliation.old_big_shift_216_vs_outside_214: 216 variants with |shift| > 2 nt and the full 5' prefix; 2 of them are not outside_measured_range because their label is mlv3p/mv (class not_measured): hsa-miR-548ae-5p mlv3p|mlv3p#3 +3, hsa-miR-8485 mv|lv3p|lv3pT|lv3p#-4 -4

R2_raw.rule: top-1 >= 0.8 x canonical (3-decimal values), all miRNAs

R2.rule: APPROVED: top-1 >= 0.8 x canonical (3-decimal values); not for miRNAs whose isomiRdb reference may differ from 22.1 (option B). 0.8 = own threshold of the tool, not calibrated.

reference_check.definition_suspect: a top-3 variant differs from the 22.1 sequence at the 5' end or inside the sequence, or carries a templated label (lv3pT/lv3pE) while its 3' tail differs from 22.1; a labelled mismatch variant (mv) does not count
reference_check.definition_may_differ: suspect AND no templated-label variant that matches 22.1 exactly covers every questioned position (lv3pE covers the whole reference, lv3pT#-k its first L-k nt) — option B, tightened by the owner on 2026-11-21
